note: Attacker-controlled NFLOG TLV bytes are scanned for the NFULA_PAYLOAD record; the found record's recordLen (24) is taken as the payload TLV size.
The first TLV admission check only rejects a zero length; it never verifies that the claimed recordLen (24) fits within tlvDataLen (20), so the under-sized capture is accepted as a full payload TLV.
payloadLen (20) is derived from the unvalidated recordLen, claiming a full 20-byte IPv4 header at payload while only 16 captured bytes remain from that offset.
Validity only checks the claimed payloadLen (20) and the version/IHL nibbles; it does not check that 20 real bytes exist at payload, so the truncated buffer is accepted as an IPv4 layer.
Reads the 4-byte ipDst field at header offset 16 (payload+16 = capture offset 24); the 24-byte capture ends there, so this 4-byte read is out of bounds.
